scientific.integrity: The proof is symbolic and all-parameter. It combines the focal paper's monotonicity/comparison theorem with Clarkson's exact von Neumann–Jordan constant and explicit Birkhoff-orthogonal extremal pairs. Endpoint cases \(p=1\) and \(p=\infty\) are verified directly; no finite experiment substitutes for proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is restricted to real \(\ell_p(I)\) with at least two coordinates and real \(L_p[0,1]\), and to \(-\infty\le t\le2\). It does not settle \(t>2\) for \(1<p<\infty\), \(p\ne2\), nor characterize all Banach spaces on which the Birkhoff restriction is nonbinding.

title: Exact Birkhoff–Takahashi constants on classical \(\ell_p\) and \(L_p\) spaces up to quadratic order
